forum.category: STM32 MPUs Products and hardware related
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@Hestering, to the community!

The [Online Support OLS](http://ols.st.com) was definitely the right point of contact; the community cannot help you, as users here help one another.

However, you did not just open one case, but two cases on the same day, with the numbers 00265734 and 00265426. It is quite possible that there are delays, for example due to the current holiday period, which is why I would like to ask you to be patient a little longer.

Thank you for our understanding.

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text: **I  have already submitted the case in ST Online Support, but have had no reply for over two weeks.**
